<script>
  (function () {
    "use strict";

    let activeSection = null;
    let scrollPositionWhenClicked = 0;
    let clickModeActive = false;

    /**
     * Devuelve la sección correspondiente al botón presionado.
     * Se busca cada vez que ocurre el clic porque la localización
     * puede reemplazar los elementos del DOM.
     */
    function getRetailersSection(element) {
      if (!element) return null;

      return element.closest(
        ".c-section.cc-retailers_logos"
      );
    }

    /**
     * Activa Department Store.
     */
    function showDepartmentStore(section) {
      if (!section) return;

      section.classList.remove("is-click-multibrand");
      section.classList.add("is-click-department");

      const departmentButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-department_store"
      );

      const multibrandButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-multi_brand-retailers"
      );

      if (departmentButton) {
        departmentButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "true"
        );
      }

      if (multibrandButton) {
        multibrandButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "false"
        );
      }

      activeSection = section;
      clickModeActive = true;
      scrollPositionWhenClicked = window.scrollY;
    }

    /**
     * Activa Multi-Brand Retailers.
     */
    function showMultibrandRetailers(section) {
      if (!section) return;

      section.classList.remove("is-click-department");
      section.classList.add("is-click-multibrand");

      const departmentButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-department_store"
      );

      const multibrandButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-multi_brand-retailers"
      );

      if (departmentButton) {
        departmentButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "false"
        );
      }

      if (multibrandButton) {
        multibrandButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "true"
        );
      }

      activeSection = section;
      clickModeActive = true;
      scrollPositionWhenClicked = window.scrollY;
    }

    /**
     * Devuelve el control a la interacción de scroll de Webflow.
     */
    function releaseClickMode() {
      if (activeSection && document.contains(activeSection)) {
        activeSection.classList.remove(
          "is-click-department",
          "is-click-multibrand"
        );
      }

      activeSection = null;
      clickModeActive = false;
    }

    /**
     * Delegación de eventos.
     *
     * El listener permanece en document aunque Webflow,
     * Weglot, la geolocalización o el selector de idioma
     * reemplacen los botones.
     */
    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      const departmentButton = event.target.closest(
        ".cc-department_store"
      );

      if (departmentButton) {
        const section = getRetailersSection(
          departmentButton
        );

        if (!section) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        showDepartmentStore(section);
        return;
      }

      const multibrandButton = event.target.closest(
        ".cc-multi_brand-retailers"
      );

      if (multibrandButton) {
        const section = getRetailersSection(
          multibrandButton
        );

        if (!section) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        showMultibrandRetailers(section);
      }
    });

    /**
     * Al volver a hacer scroll, Webflow recupera el control.
     */
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      function () {
        if (!clickModeActive) return;

        const difference = Math.abs(
          window.scrollY - scrollPositionWhenClicked
        );

        if (difference < 5) return;

        releaseClickMode();
      },
      { passive: true }
    );

    /**
     * Por si el cambio de idioma modifica la página
     * sin hacer una recarga tradicional.
     */
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", function () {
      activeSection = null;
      clickModeActive = false;
    });
  })();
</script>

  (function () {
    "use strict";

    let activeSection = null;
    let scrollPositionWhenClicked = 0;
    let clickModeActive = false;

    /**
     * Devuelve la sección correspondiente al botón presionado.
     * Se busca cada vez que ocurre el clic porque la localización
     * puede reemplazar los elementos del DOM.
     */
    function getRetailersSection(element) {
      if (!element) return null;

      return element.closest(
        ".c-section.cc-retailers_logos"
      );
    }

    /**
     * Activa Department Store.
     */
    function showDepartmentStore(section) {
      if (!section) return;

      section.classList.remove("is-click-multibrand");
      section.classList.add("is-click-department");

      const departmentButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-department_store"
      );

      const multibrandButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-multi_brand-retailers"
      );

      if (departmentButton) {
        departmentButton.setAttribute(

          "true"
        );
      }

      if (multibrandButton) {
        multibrandButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "false"
        );
      }

      activeSection = section;
      clickModeActive = true;
      scrollPositionWhenClicked = window.scrollY;
    }

    /**
     * Activa Multi-Brand Retailers.
     */
    function showMultibrandRetailers(section) {
      if (!section) return;

      section.classList.remove("is-click-department");
      section.classList.add("is-click-multibrand");

      const departmentButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-department_store"
      );

      const multibrandButton = section.querySelector(
        ".cc-multi_brand-retailers"
      );

      if (departmentButton) {
        departmentButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "false"
        );
      }

      if (multibrandButton) {
        multibrandButton.setAttribute(
          "aria-selected",
          "true"
        );
      }

      activeSection = section;
      clickModeActive = true;
      scrollPositionWhenClicked = window.scrollY;
    }

    /**
     * Devuelve el control a la interacción de scroll de Webflow.
     */
    function releaseClickMode() {
      if (activeSection && document.contains(activeSection)) {
        activeSection.classList.remove(
          "is-click-department",
          "is-click-multibrand"
        );
      }

      activeSection = null;
      clickModeActive = false;
    }

    /**
     * Delegación de eventos.
     *
     * El listener permanece en document aunque Webflow,
     * Weglot, la geolocalización o el selector de idioma
     * reemplacen los botones.
     */
    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      const departmentButton = event.target.closest(
        ".cc-department_store"
      );

      if (departmentButton) {
        const section = getRetailersSection(
          departmentButton
        );

        if (!section) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        showDepartmentStore(section);
        return;
      }

      const multibrandButton = event.target.closest(
        ".cc-multi_brand-retailers"
      );

      if (multibrandButton) {
        const section = getRetailersSection(
          multibrandButton
        );

        if (!section) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        showMultibrandRetailers(section);
      }
    });

    /**
     * Al volver a hacer scroll, Webflow recupera el control.
     */
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      function () {
        if (!clickModeActive) return;

        const difference = Math.abs(
          window.scrollY - scrollPositionWhenClicked
        );

        if (difference < 5) return;

        releaseClickMode();
      },
      { passive: true }
    );

    /**
     * Por si el cambio de idioma modifica la página
     * sin hacer una recarga tradicional.
     */
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", function () {
      activeSection = null;
      clickModeActive = false;
    });
  })();
